g.text: Soft luminous pockets. Intimate, diffuse, deep.
Shared focus, without fixed eyes or a mouth.
Purposeful formation, not a progress indicator.
A local amber change within blue
Something to examine together, not an alarm.
Original still concepts · no lines, no live status · labels describe intended meaning, not tested recognition.
Laptop first. Desk device, VR and other harness users are future design considerations.
